description: DHNpype calculates steady-state heat losses and flow properties for one supply-and-return branch. It reports section temperatures, flows, velocities and cumulative heat losses from CSV network inputs. The provider is University of Ljubljana research project, markokfs repository. Coverage: The model represents a generic single branch. It assumes one-dimensional steady flow, uniform section properties and constant thermal conductivity. Access: A public repository documents the code structure and notebook example. Nothing was executed. Licence and cost: The repository identifies MIT. Dependency and input-data terms remain separate. Limitations: It does not establish dynamic or full meshed-network behaviour. Independent reuse or sustained maintenance was not confirmed. For simulation it supports simplified district-heating and cooling branch calculations. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
